content.text: Reorganization of Fedora wiki documentation proposal:
I have moved pages per the proposal (taking artistic license in a few cases)... and will not create follow-on tickets for updating the "Outdated" and "Improvements" pages.
This task is to review the structure and content of the Fedora "user" documentation to determine:
how to potentially reorganize the pages to increase findability
The completion of this ticket should include a restructuring proposal.

renderedFields.description:
This task is to review the structure and content of the Fedora "user" documentation to determine:

  • which pages are obsolete
  • which pages need updating
  • how to potentially reorganize the pages to increase findability

The completion of this ticket should include a restructuring proposal.
